ignoreCommand: if git cat-file -e "${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD^}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then git diff --quiet "${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD^}" HEAD -- :/website :/packages :/package.json :/pnpm-lock.yaml :/pnpm-workspace.yaml; else exit 1; fi
buildCommand: pnpm --filter seroval build && pnpm --filter seroval-plugins build && pnpm build
